protocol.algorithm: on-policy REINFORCE with leave-one-out return baselines
protocol.routing_gradient: sampled rewards, no supervised action targets; exact-budget conditional-continuation probes
protocol.halting_gradient: sampled variable-length episodes, actual computation cost in reward
protocol.recurrent_gradient: detached-state score-function surrogate, uniformly sampled decision times trajectory length
protocol.layout_gate: correct answer AND positive total reward; no inference updates
protocol.starting_point: parent trained weights AND learned layout
protocol.checkpoint_selection: final continued weights/layout; validation selects fixed baseline only
protocol.fixed_baseline: best constant action at identical learned per-prompt node and core-call budgets
protocol.dense_baseline: same trained weights; native full pass, not compute matched
protocol.optimizer_resume_note: Parent did not save optimizer state; new optimizer on resumed weights/layout
protocol.behavior_policy: (1-epsilon)*softmax(logits/temperature) + epsilon*uniform over legal actions; same mixture in sampling and gradient replay
protocol.layout_update: sequentially equivalent batched geometry consolidation; original correctness-and-positive-reward gate

training.algorithm: on-policy REINFORCE with legal-action exploration mixture
